home.ddText1: Lack of technology prevents real-time data collection and analysis on malnutrition, hindering informed decisions and effective interventions.
home.dtText2: Poor access to services and monitoring:
home.ddText2: Scarcity of investment in technology limits health and nutrition services in remote areas, impeding child monitoring and family support.
home.dtText3: Lack of rapid alert and response:
home.ddText3: Without technological platforms, it's difficult to detect emerging nutritional crises, delaying aid and leaving early childhood more vulnerable.

company.origin: At the end of 2023, GuateCare was born, driven by a proposal that sought to integrate technology to improve the detection of acute malnutrition in children aged 0 to 2 years.
